dataset.name: SMD

machine-1-4.hash_authority: research/real-data-feasibility-audit@8f6ee870 datasets.json (sha256); byte counts from that audit's git-ignored local_manifest.json

dataset.train_normality: Documented normal training split; upstream publishes no train-label file. Not independently label-verified.

windowing.streams: original train and test are separate streams; no window straddles the original train/test boundary or the fit/validation boundary
windowing.primary_label: window_any_anomaly: y(t) = max(label[t-63 : t+1]) on the original test split

scaler.statistics: float64 per-channel mean and population std (ddof=0)
scaler.transform: (x - mean) / scale in float64, then cast to float32
scaler.applies_to: fit, validation and test observations of the same machine

detector.loss: mean squared reconstruction error over aligned B,W,D
detector.shuffle: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([detector_seed, zero_based_epoch, 1701])).permutation(n_fit_windows); all windows each epoch including the final partial batch
detector.selection: lowest whole-validation-window reconstruction MSE; earliest epoch on exact tie; no early stopping, scheduler, clipping, autocast or accumulation
detector.seeding: random.seed, np.random.seed, torch.manual_seed, torch.cuda.manual_seed_all with the detector seed immediately before model construction

xlstm.constructor: xLSTMAD(embedding_dim=40, features_no=38, window_size=64, lr=0.001, slstm_backend='vanilla') with sLSTM dtypes forced to float32
xlstm.extraction_backend: native CUDA sLSTM overlay (mlstm_inference_canary.install path) with weights mapped by map_vanilla_weights; common18 by phase_e2_fast_observer.FastStateObserver

lstm.architecture: Linear(38,w) -> 3 encoder nn.LSTM(w,w) -> 3 decoder nn.LSTM(w,w) -> GELU -> Linear(w,38); cuDNN disabled only inside the LSTM stack
lstm.capacity_rule: width w with trainable parameters nearest to the xLSTM count, required within +/-10%; exact tie -> smaller width
lstm.observer: phase_f_lstm_observer.Observer (manual gate replay, parity-checked against native outputs)

threshold.use: detector-sanity recall/FPR only; never enters the probe

features.stream: per detector, the original test split as one chronological stream of W64 right-edge windows t in [63, test_N); each window is scored from fresh zero recurrent state
features.feature_dtype: extracted float32, cast to float64 before history/expansion

probe.design_name: within-machine blocked diagnostic (offline, supervised, same detector; not unseen-machine transfer)
probe.eligible_rows: test right edges t in [94, test_N)
probe.blocks: L = test_N - 94; c1 = 94 + floor(L/3); c2 = 94 + floor(2L/3); train = [94, c1); validation = [c1 + 96, c2); test = [c2 + 96, test_N)
probe.embargo_rationale: complete feature receptive field is 95 observations (W64 window plus 31 extra history rows); 96 = repository PURGE constant >= 95
probe.feature_scaler: none (HGB is invariant to per-feature monotone transforms within one detector; no statistic from any block is used to transform features)
probe.selection: fit each candidate on the probe-train block only; select by average_precision_score on the probe-validation block only; exact tie -> 100; evaluate the selected candidate once on the probe-test block; no refit

estimand.cell: delta_AP = AP_test(H+I) - AP_test(H) for one (machine, detector seed, backbone)

two_way_bootstrap.rule: per replicate independently resample 3 machine rows and 3 seed columns with replacement; statistic = mean of the resampled 3x3 cell matrix; interval = 2.5/97.5 percentiles (numpy.quantile, linear)

machine_only_bootstrap.rule: fresh generator; resample 3 machine rows with replacement, all observed seeds kept; statistic = mean of resampled rows; interval = 2.5/97.5 percentiles

estimand.uncertainty_label: exploratory resampling interval; never a calibrated population 95% CI
estimand.backbone_comparison: not an estimand; xLSTM and LSTM are reported side by side only

wording.R0_POSITIVE_INCREMENT: two-way lower > 0 AND machine-only lower > 0 AND positive cells >= 7 of 9
wording.R0_NEGATIVE_INCREMENT: two-way upper < 0 AND machine-only upper < 0 AND positive cells <= 2 of 9

detector_sanity.rows: all test right edges t in [63, test_N)
detector_sanity.label: window_any_anomaly
detector_sanity.weak_detector_flag: test AUROC <= 0.55 -> flag DETECTOR_WEAK; cell retained
detector_sanity.status: diagnostic context only; never used to select seeds, backbones, machines or cells
